review_candidates.title: Hardware Engineer
review_candidates.location: Markaz Etay El Baroud, Al Buhayrah, Egypt
review_candidates.description: Company Description Orpinn is a technology-focused company dedicated to designing and delivering robust hardware solutions that support reliable and efficient systems. The organization values innovation, practical engineering, and collaboration across disciplines to build products that meet real-world performance and quality standards. Team members work closely to move ideas from concept through prototyping and into production, with a strong emphasis on testing and continuous improvement. Orpinn offers an environment where hardware engineers can contribute to impactful projects and grow their technical expertise. The company promotes an inclusive workplace that welcomes professionals from diverse backgrounds. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Hardware Engineer role based in Markaz Etay El Baroud. The Hardware Engineer will design, develop, and test electronic hardware components and systems, including circuit boards and related assemblies. Day-to-day responsibilities include creating and reviewing schematics, selecting appropriate components, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and supporting prototype build and validation. The role involves troubleshooting hardware issues, optimizing designs for performance, reliability, and manufacturability, and preparing technical documentation for internal and external stakeholders. The Hardware Engineer will also contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and ensure designs comply with relevant standards and best practices. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong skills in Hardware Development and general Hardware engineering. Candidates should possess strong skills in Circuit Design and Electronics Hardware Design. Candidates should possess strong skills in Computer Hardware and system-level integration. Relevant experience with PCB design tools, electronic test equipment, and hardware debugging techniques. Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). Ability to work on-site in Markaz Etay El Baroud and collaborate effectively in a multidisciplinary team. Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and commitment to safety, quality, and inclusive professional conduct.

review_candidates.title: Technical Sales Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description Krypton Chemical S.L. Egypt specializes in advanced chemical solutions and systems for construction, industrial, and protective applications. The company focuses on delivering high-performance products and technical expertise to clients across Egypt and the broader region. Krypton Chemical S.L. Egypt works closely with partners and customers to provide customized solutions that meet demanding technical and environmental requirements. The organization values innovation, quality, and long-term relationships, offering team members opportunities to grow their technical and commercial skills in a dynamic market. Role Description This is a full-time hybrid role based in Cairo, Egypt, with a mix of on-site client visits, office work, and some work-from-home flexibility. The Technical Sales Engineer will identify and develop new business opportunities, present technical solutions, and support existing customers in selecting appropriate chemical systems for their applications. Daily activities include conducting product demonstrations, preparing technical proposals and quotations, and following up on leads to meet sales targets. The role also involves providing pre- and post-sales technical support, troubleshooting application issues, and coordinating with internal technical and operations teams to ensure successful project delivery. The Technical Sales Engineer will maintain accurate records in CRM tools, stay current with industry standards and product developments, and represent the company at meetings, trainings, and industry events. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Technical Sales and Sales skills, with a proven ability to build relationships, manage pipelines, and close opportunities. Candidates should possess Sales Engineering and Technical Support skills to understand product specifications, interpret drawings, and guide customers in applying solutions correctly. Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, including clear spoken and written communication, presentation capabilities, and active listening. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (e.g., Chemical, Civil, Materials, or related field) or an equivalent technical discipline is preferred. Experience in construction chemicals, industrial coatings, waterproofing, or similar technical products is beneficial. Strong problem-solving abilities, customer-focused mindset, and comfort working in a field-oriented, hybrid environment. Proficiency with basic office software and CRM tools, valid driver’s license, and willingness to travel within Egypt as needed.

review_candidates.title: Lead AI & Full Stack Engineer (Co-Founder)
review_candidates.description: Lead AI & Full-Stack Engineer — Co-Founder Position: Lead AI & Full-Stack Engineer / Technical Co-Founder Type: Co-Founder Partnership Experience: 7+ Years Location: Remote About Owlera Owlera is an AI-powered career platform building a new way for students and early-career professionals to gain real-world experience, prove their abilities, and prepare for a rapidly changing world of work. We transform real internships into virtual simulated work experiences where users complete realistic projects and missions, interact with AI-powered managers, receive continuous feedback and evaluation, and build evidence of what they can actually do. For employers, Owlera provides a way to develop, evaluate, and identify talent based on real performance—not just resumes. About the Role We’re looking for an exceptional Lead AI & Full-Stack Engineer to join Owlera as a technical co-founder and long-term partner in building the company. This is a hands-on role for someone who can take ownership of the technology behind Owlera—from architecture and full-stack development to AI systems and intelligent agents. You’ll work directly with the founder to turn the product vision into a scalable, production-ready platform and help shape Owlera’s long-term technical direction. What You’ll Do * Architect and build Owlera’s web platform from frontend to backend. * Develop scalable APIs, databases, authentication, and core platform infrastructure. * Build polished, responsive user experiences. * Design and integrate AI-powered features across the product. * Build AI agents capable of using tools, data, APIs, and multi-step workflows. * Work with LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, structured outputs, and tool calling. * Integrate third-party platforms and services. * Own deployment, performance, reliability, security, and scalability. * Make key technical and architectural decisions. * Establish engineering standards and best practices. * Help recruit and lead the future engineering team. * Work closely with the founder on product and technology strategy. What We’re Looking For * 7+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Strong expertise in both frontend and backend development. * Proven experience building and launching production web applications. * Strong experience with technologies such as React, Next.js, TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js and/or Python. * Strong knowledge of APIs, databases, authentication, cloud infrastructure, and system architecture. * Hands-on experience integrating LLMs and generative AI into real applications. * Experience building AI agents or agentic workflows. * Familiarity with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, tool/function calling, and AI evaluation. * Experience with cloud platforms and production deployments. * Strong understanding of scalability, security, performance, and software architecture. * Ability to take a product from idea → architecture → development → deployment → scale. * Startup experience is highly preferred. Who We’re Looking For We’re not looking for someone who only manages engineers or someone who has simply experimented with AI APIs. We’re looking for a senior hands-on builder who can look at an ambitious product idea and figure out how to architect and build it. You should be entrepreneurial, highly technical, product-minded, comfortable with ambiguity, and excited about helping build a company—not simply completing assigned development tasks. Why This Is Different This isn’t just another senior engineering position. You’ll join Owlera as a technical co-founder, working directly with the founder and having meaningful influence over: Product → Technology → Architecture → AI → Engineering Team → Company Direction You’ll help build the technical foundation of Owlera and shape how the platform evolves as the company grows. Position Details Role: Lead AI & Full-Stack Engineer / Technical Co-Founder Experience: 7+ Years Location: Remote Position: Co-Founder Partnership If you’ve built serious software products, understand modern AI deeply, can work across the entire technology stack, and want to help build a technology company rather than simply work for one, we’d love to hear from you.
